subtitle: Lesson 16 · Enterprise Cloud Architecture & Advanced Capstone

code:
runbook says:  "promote secondary, repoint DNS, scale up"
reality says:  state drifted, a secret expired,
               an IP was hardcoded 18 months ago

# a document describes INTENDED behavior
# only running it proves ACTUAL behavior
caption: Infrastructure drifts constantly. The document describing it doesn't drift with it.

steps.label: Catches: missing owners
steps.sub: an unclear escalation path, a step nobody can explain

steps.label: Misses: stale DNS TTL
steps.sub: traffic keeps hitting the dead region longer than assumed

steps.label: Misses: hardcoded endpoints
steps.sub: config still pointing at the primary region's database

eyebrow: A real drill forces the gaps open

steps.label: Trigger the real failure condition
steps.sub: on your own schedule, controlling the blast radius

steps.label: Start a real clock
steps.sub: watch DNS propagate, the secondary promote, traffic return

steps.label: Measure RTO/RPO, don't estimate them
steps.sub: the real number is often not the estimated one

eyebrow: A failed test vs. an untested plan
code:
failed DR test:
  -> found the expired credential NOW
  -> on a controlled schedule, with time to fix it

untested DR plan:
  -> carries the SAME risk, invisibly
  -> found only when a real disaster forces it
caption: A test that fails did its job. A plan that was never run just hasn't failed yet.
